title: Export file
description: Characters moving between apps, with the packs they pin: one file for a roster, or for linked characters (a crew, a companion). Each pack is a reference by ID and version, which the receiving app supplies, or an embedded release, so the file opens with nothing else (a bundle). It carries only data: no engine and no sheet, which is derived.

specVersion.description: The OCF spec version this file was written against.

characters.description: One or more character files, extensions and homebrew included. Their `id`s are unique within the export.

packs.description: Every pack version a character pins, once each.

reference.description: A pack by ID and version, for the receiving app to supply.

url.description: Where the pack release can be fetched.

embedded.description: A pack release carried in the file.

integrity.description: The release's hash: `sha256-` and the base64 SHA-256 of its canonical JSON (RFC 8785). Decides whether the receiving app's own copy of the same ID and version is this release.
